project.name: osgi/domains/netplan/netplan-ingress-contract
project.description: The HOST face of the netplan contract — what BOTH realms genuinely consume: the one coordinate the netplan scion stores its projection at and the host fetches it back from (the operator's kubeconfig contexts read their addressing there). netplan-contract is type=contract, OSGi-only, so the host cannot compile against it, and spelling the slug as a string host-side is the mismatch the single-source-of-truth discipline forbids. type=dual-realm, like incus-ingress-contract: staged as a bundle OSGi-side AND kept flat host-side. The projection itself crosses as JSON (the host reads it as a JsonNode, never a netplan type).
